sources.entry: iTunes Graphs - macOS app to visualise your iTunes library as graphs.

summary.one_liner: A Cocoa macOS app that visualises your iTunes library as pie charts broken down by artist, genre, and decade.
summary.what_it_does: iTunes Graphs is a Cocoa-based macOS application that reads your iTunes library and displays it as a series of pie charts. The README names three supported graphs: artists, genres, and decades. The author also mentions an iOS version. A build is provided in the GitHub Releases section. The README is brief and does not describe the chart interactions or data-handling details.
use_cases: see which artists dominate my music collection
break down my library by genre
chart my music collection by decade
how_to_run: Download the build from the Releases section on GitHub
notable: Pie-chart views of an iTunes library by artist, genre, and decade
A companion iOS version is mentioned by the author
caveats: Requires macOS; the README only describes a Cocoa macOS build
The README does not state the license or current maintenance status
Only three chart types are listed as supported
